title: Multiton Pattern
overview: Extend Singleton to allow a controlled number of named instances, each identified by a key.
useCases: When you want to maintain a single instance of a class per ID/Key
Named instances that must each be unique and globally accessible
Managing a fixed set of resources identified by a key (e.g. one database connection per database name)
exampleUses: Per-tenant configuration objects in a multi-tenant application, where each tenant gets exactly one config instance
Locale-specific resource bundles where one bundle per language code is loaded and cached globally
Game character archetypes where each character class (Warrior, Mage, Rogue) has one shared stats template
